title: Do not trust vendor reviews
review:
The Knot has a policy that protects vendors against negative feedback back from legitimate customers. If you try to leave an honest review, the vendor can dispute that you are a customer (even if the vendor simultaneously reaches out to you apologizing for their bad service, therefore proving you are a customer). The Knot then requires you to submit specific documentation that you were indeed a customer, including signed contracts and receipts that have personal financial information.  They will not accept any other clear proof, including said emails where the vendor is openly admitting that the issues mentioned in your review are facts. If the vendor fails to provide the documentation to you within 7 days, your review is scrubbed. 
TLDR: the knot is not a trustworthy site and the reviews are curated.
